prompt: Do you know ___ bus stops near the museum?
why: which 修飾 bus，詢問哪一路公車。

prompt: Which detail would make a route easier to follow?
answer: A landmark at the point where you turn.
options: A landmark at the point where you turn.
why: 轉彎處的地標能提供可操作的定位線索。

prompt: Professor Higgins ___ at Oxford University for over twenty-five years, and he still conducts seminars every Tuesday.
why: 【考點解構】時間副詞 for over twenty-five years（長達25年）搭配後句 and he still conducts（至今仍在授課），表明動作始於過去並持續至現在，必須使用現在完成式 has taught。

prompt: Mr. Lin ________ in this middle school since he moved to Hualien five years ago.
why: since 引導起點，主要子句用 has taught。

prompt: 哪一句是正確的？
answer: I have lived here for 5 years.
options: I have lived here for 5 years.
I have lived here since 5 years.
why: 5 years 是時間段，必須搭配 for，不可用 since。

prompt: We ___ the museum last Sunday.
why: last Sunday 是結束的過去；visited 是過去式。have visited 不搭這個時間，have visit 缺過去分詞。

prompt: Mr. Davis ___ in this tranquil mountain town since he retired in 2015.
why: since + 過去時間點，主要子句必須使用現在完成式 has lived 表示動作持續至今。 since 提示現在完成式，主詞 Mr. Davis 搭配 has lived。

prompt: We ___ each other for more than ten years since elementary school.
why: for + 一段時間，表示從過去持續至今之狀態，動詞使用現在完成式 have known。 for ten years 搭配完成式 have known。

prompt: Have you ever ___ to Alishan to appreciate the breathtaking sunrise?
why: Have you ever been to... 表示「是否曾造訪某地之經驗」（gone to 表去了尚未返回）。 造訪經驗使用 have been to。

prompt: Dr. Thornton ___ at Cambridge University for twenty-five years, and he still teaches there today.
why: for twenty-five years 持續態搭配現在完成式 has taught。 持續時間片語搭配 has taught。

prompt: How long ___ you had this reliable laptop computer?
why: How long have you had... 詢問持有狀態持續了多久。 完成式疑問句助動詞用 have。

prompt: She ___ in London since she graduated from Oxford last autumn.
why: since 子句接過去式，主要子句使用現在完成式 has resided。 since 對應現在完成式 has resided。

prompt: My uncle ___ in Germany for five years now, so he speaks German fluently.
why: for five years now 表示從過去持續到現在，使用現在完成式 has lived。正確答案為「has lived」。

prompt: Tony ___ a member of the school debate club since seventh grade.
why: since seventh grade 搭配現在完成式 has been。 持續至今的身分選 has been。

prompt: This historic stone bridge ___ by ancient craftsmen five centuries ago.
why: 主詞 stone bridge 為承受動作之物，時間片語 five centuries ago 提示過去式，被動為 was built。 過去被動語態 was built by...

prompt: Millions of plastic bottles ___ every single minute across the globe.
why: 複數主詞 bottles 搭配現在被動語態 are discarded。 複數現在被動選 are discarded。

prompt: The school auditorium ___ thoroughly before the graduation ceremony yesterday.
why: yesterday 提示過去式被動 was cleaned。 過去被動選 was cleaned。

prompt: These classic novels ___ by Charles Dickens in the nineteenth century.
why: 複數主詞 novels 在過去被寫成，使用 were written。 複數過去被動選 were written。

prompt: Every year, coffee beans ___ from Brazil and Colombia to roasting plants in Taiwan.
why: 常態商務被動使用 are imported。 現在被動選 are imported。

prompt: All chemical waste ___ disposed of according to strict safety regulations.
why: 助動詞被動結構：must be + p.p. (disposed of)。 助動詞後加 be + p.p.，選 must be。

prompt: This confidential document ___ to anyone outside the executive board.
why: 否定被動：should not be + p.p. (revealed)。 否定助動詞被動選 should not be revealed。

prompt: The damaged playground equipment ___ immediately before students get hurt.
why: needs to be + p.p. (repaired) 表示需要被修復。 need to be repaired 結構完整。

prompt: Your application form ___ to the admissions office before May 15th.
why: has to be + p.p. (submitted) 表必須被遞交。 義務被動選 has to be submitted。

prompt: Valuable antique items in the museum ___ touched by tourists.
why: cannot be + p.p. 表示不可被…。 禁止被動選 cannot be touched。

prompt: The school sports day ___ if torrential rain continues tomorrow.
why: 未來式被動：will be + p.p. (canceled)。 未來被動選 will be canceled。

prompt: Trash ___ into designated recycling bins on campus.
why: ought to be + p.p. (thrown) 道德規範被動。 道德被動選 ought to be thrown。

prompt: Seatbelts ___ during the entire duration of the flight.
why: 安全帶承受穿戴動作，must be worn。 法規義務被動選 must be worn。

prompt: All library books ___ within two weeks of borrowing.
why: 書籍承受歸還動作，must be returned。 被動歸還選 must be returned。

prompt: This delicate glass vase ___ with extreme caution.
why: 花瓶承受拿取動作，should be handled with caution。 拿取被動選 should be handled。

prompt: A dictionary is a useful reference book ___ explains the meanings of words.
why: 先行詞 a book 為物，在關係子句中作主詞，選 that（或 which）。 先行詞為物選 that。

prompt: The solar panels ___ were installed on our school roof generate clean electricity.
why: 先行詞 solar panels 為物，當關係子句主詞用 that（或 which）。 物品先行詞選 that。

prompt: The coach made all athletes ___ ten kilometers around the track and let them ___ for fifteen minutes.
why: 【考點解構】使役動詞 make 與 let 受詞後接「主動原型動詞 (V)」作為受詞補語，口訣「使役動詞後接受詞做動作，省略 to 用原型」，故選 run; rest。

prompt: The strict teacher made all students ________ their mobile phones during class.
why: 使役動詞 make 接原形動詞 turn off。

prompt: 哪一句是正確的？
answer: He made me clean the room.
options: He made me clean the room.
He made me to clean the room.
why: 使役動詞 make 後面直接接原形動詞 clean，嚴禁加 to。

prompt: The inspiring movie made all the audience ___ tears of joy.
why: 使役動詞 make + 受詞 + 原形動詞 (V) 作受詞補語。 make + O + 原形動詞 shed。

prompt: Dad had the experienced mechanic ___ the car engine yesterday.
why: 使役動詞 have + 人 + 原形動詞 (inspect)。 have + 人 + 原形動詞 inspect。

prompt: Mom let my younger sister ___ her friends over for a sleepover.
why: 使役動詞 let + 受詞 + 原形動詞 (invite)。 let + O + 原形動詞 invite。

prompt: The teacher had the students ___ their compositions in pairs.
why: have + 人 + 原形動詞 (revise)。 have + 人 + 原形動詞 revise。

prompt: Please don't let small failures ___ you from pursuing your goals.
why: let + 受詞 + 原形動詞 (stop)。 let + O + 原形動詞 stop。

prompt: The funny joke told by Tony made everyone in the room ___.
why: make + 受詞 + 原形動詞 (laugh)。 make + O + 原形動詞 laugh。

prompt: Sad news often makes people ___ deeply heartbroken and anxious.
why: make + 人 + 原形連綴動詞 (feel)。 make + 人 + 原形 feel。

prompt: Grandpa ___ smoke heavily, but he quit twenty years ago.
why: used to + 原形動詞 (V) 表示「過去曾經（現在已無）的習慣或狀態」。 過去曾經選 used to + 原形動詞。

prompt: After living in London for three years, Leo is now used to ___ on the left.
why: be used to + V-ing（或名詞）表示「習慣於…」。 be used to 接動名詞 driving。

prompt: Taiwanese students are used to ___ uniforms to school on weekdays.
why: are used to + V-ing (wearing)。 習慣於穿著選 wearing。

prompt: There ___ be an old wooden bridge over this river decades ago.
why: There used to be... 表示「過去曾經存在著…」。 過去曾存在用 There used to be。

prompt: Tony is gradually getting used to ___ up at 6:00 a.m. every morning.
why: get used to + V-ing (waking) 表示逐漸適應習慣。 get used to 接動名詞 waking。

prompt: We ___ play hide-and-seek in this neighborhood when we were children.
why: used to + 原形動詞 play。 過去常做用 used to play。

prompt: Did you ___ live near the harbor before moving to this apartment?
why: 疑問句配合助動詞 Did，動詞回歸原形：Did you use to live...? Did 疑問句中回歸原形 use to。

prompt: 哪一句是正確的？
answer: The girl who speaks English well is my sister.
options: The girl who speaks English well is my sister.
The girl speaks English well is my sister.
why: 關代當主格絕對不可省略，否則全句會出現兩個主要動詞。

prompt: What did Mr. Chang lend to the author?
passage: Everyone remembers a mentor who inspired their curiosity. For me, that person was Mr. Chang, the physics teacher whose passion for the cosmos was infectious. The telescope he lent me opened up a universe of wonders. Today, the dreams he nurtured continue to guide my scientific journey.
options: The first-floor book borrowing desk and online reservation.
why: 文章依據：A telescope.

prompt: The delicious strawberry cake ___ Mom baked yesterday was gone in minutes.
why: 先行詞 cake 為物，作 baked 的受詞，使用 that。 受格修飾物選 that。

prompt: Is this the leather wallet ___ you lost on the playground yesterday?
why: 先行詞 wallet 為物，作 lost 的受詞，選 that。 物之受格選 that。

prompt: Do you know ___?
why: 嵌入問句用 where + 主詞 + 動詞，不沿用直接問句倒裝。

prompt: Nobody knows where ________ last night.
why: 間接問句語序為 where he went。

prompt: 哪一句是正確的？
answer: Do you know where he lives?
options: Do you know where he lives?
Do you know where does he live?
why: 間接問句內部必須恢復直述句語序，不可保留助動詞 does。

prompt: Why do professionals use indirect questions?
passage: In professional communication, polite language creates trust. Instead of asking bluntly, 'Where is the manager?', professional clients prefer, 'Could you please tell me where the manager is?' Indirect questions show respect and consideration.
answer: Because they show respect and consideration.
options: Because they show respect and consideration.
The first-floor book borrowing desk and online reservation.
why: 文章依據：Because they show respect and consideration.

prompt: Which sentence is an OPINION?
answer: I think our school needs more trees.
options: I think our school needs more trees.
why: I think 表示主觀意見；其他句子可以查證。

prompt: Which response politely disagrees?
answer: That’s a good point, but I see it differently.
options: That’s a good point, but I see it differently.
why: 先肯定再提出不同看法，是有禮貌的回應方式。

prompt: It is very hot and humid in Taipei today, ___?
why: 前肯後否規則：前面為肯定句 It is...，附加問句使用否定縮寫 isn't it？ 前肯後否，be動詞對應 isn't it。

prompt: Tony didn't go to the movie with you yesterday, ___?
why: 前否後肯規則：前面為 didn't go，附加問句使用肯定助動詞 did he？ 前否後肯，過去助動詞對應 did he。

prompt: You can speak both English and Japanese fluently, ___?
why: 前面為肯定情態句 You can...，附加問句使用 can't you？ 助動詞 can 否定附加為 can't you。

prompt: The students have finished their math homework, ___?
why: 現在完成式 have finished 前肯後否，附加問句用 haven't they？ 完成式 have 對應 haven't they。

prompt: She walks to school every morning, ___?
why: 一般現在式第三人稱單數 walks，附加問句使用助動詞 doesn't she？ 一般動詞三單對應 doesn't she。

prompt: There are twenty students in Class 601, ___?
why: There are 句型附加問句主詞仍使用 there，前肯後否為 aren't there？ There be 句型附加問句用 aren't there。

prompt: Let's go have a picnic in the botanical garden, ___?
why: Let's 開頭的祈使句提議，附加問句固定使用 shall we？ Let's 提議句固定接 shall we。

prompt: Open the window to let some fresh air in, ___?
why: 肯定祈使句要求對方做某事，附加問句使用 will you？ 祈使句請求對方選 will you。

prompt: Peter has never been to London before, ___?
why: 句中含否定副詞 never 視為否定句，附加問句需用肯定 has he？ 含 never 視為否定句，後接肯定 has he。

prompt: Your parents won't be angry with you, ___?
why: 前面為 won't (will not) 否定，附加問句使用肯定 will they？ won't 對應肯定 will they。

prompt: Our science teacher demonstrated ___ heat causes metal bars to expand.
why: demonstrated 後接完整的陳述名詞子句，引導詞使用 that（不具疑問含義）。 接完整客觀事實子句用 that。

prompt: Scientists believe ___ global climate change demands urgent international cooperation.
why: believe 後接完整客觀主張子句，引導詞用 that。 動詞受格名詞子句用 that。

prompt: Doctors emphasize ___ adequate hydration is vital for maintaining renal health.
why: emphasize 後接完整醫學事實名詞子句，使用 that。 強調客觀事實用 that 子句。

prompt: The weather forecast predicts ___ temperatures will drop drastically over the weekend.
why: predict 後接完整預測內容子句，使用 that。 predict 後接 that 子句。

prompt: Emily discovered ___ her ancient ancestors were renowned ceramic artisans.
why: discovered 後接完整歷史事實子句，使用 that。 發現事實用 that 子句。

prompt: Excuse me, could you please tell me where the nearest post office ___?
why: 間接問句需使用「陳述正裝語序」：疑問詞 (where) + 主詞 (the post office) + 動詞 (is)，不可倒裝！ 間接問句使用正裝語序 where + S + V (is)。

prompt: Nobody in the classroom knows when the math exam ___ next week.
why: 間接問句正裝語序：when + 主詞 (the exam) + 動詞 (will take place)。 間接問句不倒裝，選 will take place。

prompt: I wonder why Tony ___ absent from school yesterday.
why: 正裝語序：why + 主詞 (Tony) + 動詞過去式 (was)。 間接問句不倒裝，選 was。

prompt: Do you know who ___ that revolutionary scientific discovery?
why: who 當疑問詞同時兼任主詞，後方直接接動詞 made。 who 作主詞直接接動詞 made。

prompt: The tourist asked a passerby how much the museum admission ticket ___.
why: 正裝語序：how much + 主詞 (the ticket) + 動詞過去式 (cost)。 正裝語序不倒裝選 cost。

prompt: I can't remember where I ___ my house keys last night.
why: 正裝語序：where + 主詞 (I) + 過去動詞 (put)。 間接問句正裝選 put。

prompt: The teacher asked Emily why she ___ her project assignment late.
why: 正裝語序：why + 主詞 (she) + 過去動詞 (submitted)。 正裝語序選 submitted。

prompt: Could you show me how I ___ operate this new microwave oven?
why: 正裝語序：how + 主詞 (I) + 助動詞 (can) + 原形動詞 (operate)。 主詞在助動詞前選 can。

prompt: According to the notice, what will happen to overdue book fines during renovation?
passage: Notice: The Heritage Library will undergo acoustic ceiling renovations from March 1st to March 15th. During this period, the third-floor study rooms will be closed. However, the first-floor book borrowing desk and online reservation services will remain fully functional from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. daily. Fines for overdue books due during the closure will be waived automatically.
options: They will be charged when the library reopens.
why: 依原文末句，逾期罰款自動免除。

prompt: Announcement: "The museum tour starts at 10:30—sorry, 11:00—at the main gate." Best note?
why: sorry 後面是更正，要記最後確認的 11:00。

prompt: ___ the torrential rainfall, the outdoor marathon proceeded as scheduled.
why: despite 為「介系詞」，後方接名詞片語 (the torrential rainfall)；although 為連接詞需接完整子句！ 後接名詞片語選介系詞 Despite。

prompt: We arrived at the airport on time ___ the severe traffic congestion.
why: in spite of 為介系詞片語，後接名詞片語 the severe traffic congestion。 後接名詞片語選 in spite of。

prompt: The resilient climber reached the mountain peak ___ the freezing winds.
why: 後接名詞片語 the freezing winds，使用介系詞 despite。 後接名詞片語選 despite。

prompt: ___ feeling extremely exhausted after the hike, Emily helped prepare dinner.
why: In spite of 為介系詞片語，後接動名詞短語 feeling extremely exhausted；despite 本身就是介系詞，不可寫成 despite of；Because 與 Since 表原因，不符語意。正確答案為「In spite of」。

prompt: ___ having little formal musical training, Sam composed a stunning symphony.
why: Despite 為介系詞，後接動名詞短語 having little formal musical training；in spite 必須加 of；Because 與 Due to 表原因，不符語意。正確答案為「Despite」。

prompt: She bought the handbag ___ its very high price.
why: 後接名詞片語 its very high price，使用介系詞片語 in spite of。正確答案為「in spite of」。

prompt: The brave sailors kept going ___ the terrible storm around them.
why: 後接名詞片語 the terrible storm，選介系詞 despite。正確答案為「despite」。

prompt: The author describes the ancient ruins with deep respect and wonder. What is the author's tone?
why: 文學閱讀語調分析：敬仰讚賞 (Respectful and admiring)。 正確選項為「Respectful and admiring」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: The text says that when the scientist first shared her new idea, many traditional scientists refused to believe it. We can infer that her hypothesis was initially met with:
answer: Skepticism and disbelief from conservative colleagues
options: Skepticism and disbelief from conservative colleagues
why: 文中說許多傳統派科學家「拒絕相信」，可推論她的假說最初受到保守同僚的懷疑與不信。正確答案為「Skepticism and disbelief from conservative colleagues」。

prompt: An article about renewable energy ends with: 'Our government should invest more in solar and wind power now.' What is the author's main purpose?
answer: To advocate for sustainable energy policies
options: To discourage people from using electricity
To advocate for sustainable energy policies
why: 文末直接呼籲政府投資太陽能與風力發電，可見作者的目的是倡導永續能源政策。正確答案為「To advocate for sustainable energy policies」。

prompt: The writer makes fun of celebrities' shallow fashion trends. What is the writer's attitude?
why: 諷刺語氣判斷：批判嘲弄 (Critical and mocking)。 正確選項為「Critical and mocking」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: In the life story, the inventor grew up very poor but never gave up. We can infer:
answer: Hard work and dedication can help people overcome poverty.
options: Wealth is necessary for technological innovation.
Hard work and dedication can help people overcome poverty.
Luck is the only factor in human achievement.
why: 發明家靠毅力克服貧困，可推論努力與專注能幫助人克服貧窮。正確答案為「Hard work and dedication can help people overcome poverty.」。

prompt: In describing the deforestation crisis, the author cites alarming extinction rates. The purpose is to:
answer: Emphasize the catastrophic consequences of rainforest destruction
options: Emphasize the catastrophic consequences of rainforest destruction
why: 論據功能判定：強調災難性嚴重後果。 正確選項為「Emphasize the catastrophic consequences of rainforest destruction」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: The article explores contrasting opinions on artificial intelligence. The passage is mainly organized by:
answer: Comparison and contrast of potential risks and benefits
options: Comparison and contrast of potential risks and benefits
why: 篇章結構分析：比較對照 (Comparison and contrast)。 正確選項為「Comparison and contrast of potential risks and benefits」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: The author describes the local hero's brave sacrifice in a very touching way. What is the mood?
why: 文章氣氛基調分析：莊嚴動人 (Solemn and moving)。 正確選項為「Solemn and deeply moving」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: The timetable says 4 p.m. A newer notice says the bus now leaves at 4:30 p.m. When does it leave?
why: 更新通知明示更改時間，應用新資訊修正原時刻表。

prompt: If a passenger wants to take the 9:30 a.m. ferry, what time MUST they check in by?
passage: Email from Captain Lee: 'Passengers traveling to Orchid Island must check in at Harbor Terminal 30 minutes before departure. Due to afternoon squalls, all sailings after 2:00 p.m. are cancelled. Morning sailings depart at 7:30 a.m., 9:30 a.m., and 11:30 a.m.'
why: 信中規定須在開船前 30 分鐘報到，9:30 往前推 30 分鐘為 9:00 a.m。

prompt: You can choose ___ the chocolate cake or the strawberry cheesecake.
why: either A or B 表示「兩者擇一」。 兩者選一搭配 either... or。

prompt: Neither Leo nor his sister ___ to participate in the marathon race.
why: 就近原則：靠近動詞的 his sister 為第三人稱單數，動詞使用單數 wants！ 就近原則：單數 sister 決定 wants。

prompt: Neither of the two candidates ___ sufficient leadership experience.
why: Neither of + 複數名詞在正式文法與考試中視為單數，動詞用 has（口語雖常聽到 have，但書面以單數為準）。正確答案為「has」。

prompt: Neither of my parents ___ coffee; they both drink green tea.
why: Neither of + 複數名詞在正式文法與考試中視為單數，動詞用 drinks（口語雖常聽到 drink，但書面以單數為準）。正確答案為「drinks」。

prompt: Neither the principal nor the teachers ___ to cancel the sports day.
why: 就近原則：the teachers 為複數，動詞使用原形 want。 就近原則複數 teachers 決定 want。

prompt: Emily is not only intelligent ___ extremely hardworking in her studies.
why: not only A but also B 相關連接詞結構，表示「不僅…而且…」。 not only 固定搭配 but also。

prompt: Reading books not only expands knowledge ___ stimulates creative thinking.
why: not only expands... but also stimulates... 連接兩個對等的第三人稱單數動詞。 連接對等動詞選 but also。

prompt: Tony can speak not only English ___ French fluently.
why: not only English but also French 連接對等名詞。 連接對等名詞選 but also。

prompt: The new community library is not only spacious ___ very modern.
why: not only spacious but also very modern 連接對等形容詞。 連接對等形容詞選 but also。

prompt: Not only Tony but also his teammates ___ praised by the school principal.
why: 就近原則：靠近動詞的 teammates 為複數，過去被動使用 were praised！ 就近原則：複數 teammates 決定 were。

prompt: Physical exercise not only strengthens muscles ___ improves sleep quality.
why: not only strengthens... but also improves... 對等動詞。 連接對等動詞選 but also。

prompt: She is admired not only for her talent ___ for her extraordinary modesty.
why: not only for... but also for... 連接對等介系詞片語。 連接對等介系詞片語選 but also。

prompt: The typhoon brought not only violent winds ___ torrential rainfall.
why: not only winds but also rainfall 連接對等名詞受詞。 連接對等名詞選 but also。

prompt: NOTICE: 'Trespassers will be prosecuted.' What does this sign mean?
answer: People entering without permission will face legal action.
options: People are encouraged to enter freely.
Visitors can park here for free.
People entering without permission will face legal action.
The building is open for public tours.
why: 法律警示牌句意解析：未經許可進入將面臨法律究辦。 正確選項為「People entering without permission will face legal action.」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: WARNING: 'Slippery when wet.' Where would you most likely see this sign?
answer: Near a swimming pool or newly mopped corridor
options: On a bookshelf in a classroom
On a television screen in an office
Near a swimming pool or newly mopped corridor
why: 生活告示情境判斷：泳池或濕滑地面。 正確選項為「Near a swimming pool or newly mopped corridor」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: ANNOUNCEMENT: 'All flights delayed due to dense fog.' What caused the flight delay?
answer: Very low visibility caused by thick fog
options: Very low visibility caused by thick fog
why: 公告寫 due to dense fog，濃霧造成能見度極低，因此航班延誤。正確答案為「Very low visibility caused by thick fog」。

prompt: CHART NOTE: 'Sales surged by 40% in Q3.' What does 'surged' imply in this context?
why: 商業圖表詞彙辨析：surge 表巨幅激增。 正確選項為「Increased dramatically and rapidly」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: METRO NOTICE: 'Mind the gap between the train and the platform.' What is the advice?
answer: Step carefully over the opening when boarding.
options: Run quickly into the train car.
Leave your baggage on the platform.
Step carefully over the opening when boarding.
Do not look at the tracks below.
why: 大眾運輸警示：小心跨越空隙。 正確選項為「Step carefully over the opening when boarding.」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: FOOD LABEL: 'Best before October 15, 2026.' What should consumers understand?
answer: The product maintains optimal quality before this date.
options: The food becomes poisonous immediately after October 15.
The product was manufactured on October 15.
The item cannot be opened until October 15.
The product maintains optimal quality before this date.
why: 食品標籤認知：最佳賞味品質期。 正確選項為「The product maintains optimal quality before this date.」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: RESTAURANT SIGN: 'Please wait to be seated.' What are patrons expected to do?
answer: Wait for a staff member to guide them to a table.
options: Wait for a staff member to guide them to a table.
Find any empty table and sit down immediately.
Go directly to the kitchen to place an order.
Pay the bill before entering the dining area.
why: 用餐文化規範：等候帶位入座。 正確選項為「Wait for a staff member to guide them to a table.」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: CAMPUS NOTICE: 'Bicycles parked improperly will be impounded.' What will happen to illegally parked bikes?
answer: They will be confiscated and removed by campus security.
options: They will be repaired free of charge.
They will be confiscated and removed by campus security.
They will be awarded a safety certificate.
They will be rented to other students.
why: 校規告示理解：違規扣押移除。 正確選項為「They will be confiscated and removed by campus security.」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: MUSEUM SIGN: 'Flash photography strictly prohibited.' What action is forbidden?
answer: Taking pictures with the camera flash turned on.
options: Looking closely at the ancient paintings.
Taking pictures with the camera flash turned on.
why: flash photography 指開閃光燈拍照，因此被禁止的是開著相機閃光燈拍照。正確答案為「Taking pictures with the camera flash turned on.」。

prompt: WEATHER ADVISORY: 'Gale warning in coastal areas.' What precautions should residents take?
answer: Secure outdoor objects and avoid ocean shores.
options: Go swimming in the coastal waters.
Open all windows wide to let wind in.
Secure outdoor objects and avoid ocean shores.
why: 防災警報常識：防強風遠離海岸。 正確選項為「Secure outdoor objects and avoid ocean shores.」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

prompt: The committee considers the newly formulated environmental policy ________ for urban resilience.
why: consider + O + Adj.，形容詞 essential 作受詞補語。

prompt: What is the sentence pattern of 'researchers consider the human brain an extraordinary mechanism'?
passage: In contemporary neuroscience, researchers, despite numerous methodological obstacles, consider the human brain an extraordinary computational mechanism. Although sensory inputs constantly flood the cortex, specialized neural circuits keep consciousness remarkably stable. Understanding these fundamental mechanisms enables cognitive scientists to develop revolutionary therapeutic interventions.
options: To introduce the adverse result of algorithmic feeds prioritizing sensationalism.
Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
why: 文章依據：S + V + O + OC (Pattern 5)

prompt: I clearly remember ___ the lab door, so the key must be somewhere else. Please remember ___ it again tonight.
why: remember V-ing＝記得做過（已發生）；remember to V＝記得要去做（尚未發生）。第一句回想已經鎖過門，第二句提醒今晚要鎖。

prompt: Our international science seminar will officially commence ___ 9:00 a.m. ___ Monday morning ___ early October.
why: 【考點解構】套用倒金字塔法則：特定時間點 9:00 a.m. 用 at；特定某天的早晨 (Monday morning) 用 on；月份十月 (October) 用 in，因此唯一正確搭配為 at; on; in。

prompt: All the members of the expedition are looking forward to ________ the summit at sunrise.
why: look forward to + V-ing 為固定介系詞搭配，表示期待。

prompt: Why does 'accustomed to' take 'exercising' instead of 'exercise'?
passage: Psychologists distinguish between striving to achieve goals and maintaining daily routines. When people attempt to establish a new habit, they often struggle with procrastination. Experts suggest breaking big challenges into small tasks. Instead of planning to run ten miles every weekend, committed individuals begin by walking fifteen minutes daily. After people become accustomed to exercising regularly, the habit continues almost automatically, without much mental effort.
answer: Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
options: Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
Because 'recommend that' requires the subjunctive mood (should + base form).
The entire preceding fact that mold had dissolved surrounding staphylococcus colonies.
why: 文章依據：Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.

prompt: We finished ___ the equipment.
why: finish 後用動名詞 checking。

prompt: It is believed that the old bridge was built in the 12th century. → The old bridge is believed ___ in the 12th century.
why: 建造（過去）早於「被相信」（現在），而且橋是被建造的，所以用完成式被動不定詞 to have been built。

prompt: Which sentence uses an inanimate subject naturally?
answer: The heavy rain delayed the train.
options: The heavy rain delayed the train.
The train was delay by rain.
why: rain 是無生命主詞，delayed 是限定動詞，句子自然。The train was delay by rain 缺過去分詞（應為 was delayed）；The rain delaying the train 缺限定動詞。

prompt: The manuscript, discovered in the monastery archives, is believed ________ by a fourteenth-century monk.
why: 手稿在過去被寫成，故選用完成被動不定詞 to have been written。

prompt: 哪一句是正確的？
answer: The ancient fortress is believed to have been built in the third century.
options: The ancient fortress is believed to have been built in the third century.
The ancient fortress is believed to build in the third century.
why: 堡壘是被建造的 (被動)，且發生在過去 (先發生)，需使用完成被動不定詞 to have been built。

prompt: The machine must ___ before repair.
why: machine 承受關閉動作；must + be + 過去分詞。

prompt: The suspect is alleged ___ the corporate database from an offshore server.
why: be alleged to have + p.p. 表示「據指控先前曾做過某事」（完成不定詞表示動作發生在被指控之前）。 據稱曾做過選 to have breached。

prompt: The historic temple is widely deemed ___ the crown jewel of ancient Taiwanese architecture.
why: be deemed to be + 名詞/形容詞，意為「被視為、被認為是」。 被視為選 to be。

prompt: The ancient Egyptian pharaoh was believed ___ magnificent golden tombs.
why: was believed to have + p.p. 表過去被相信曾下令建造。 完成不定詞選 to have commissioned。

prompt: The manager was reported ___ millions of dollars from the company before he ran away.
why: was reported to have + p.p. 表示「據報導先前曾做過某事」，偷錢發生在被報導之前，用完成不定詞 to have stolen。正確答案為「to have stolen」。

prompt: The corporate merger is expected ___ finalized before the end of the fiscal quarter.
why: is expected to be finalized（被動敲定完成）。 預期被敲定選 to be。

prompt: The novel is said ___ over fifty million copies around the world.
why: is said to have sold：銷售發生在「據說」之前，用完成不定詞 to have + p.p。正確答案為「to have sold」。

prompt: Please tell me ___.
why: 間接問句採主詞 she + 過去式 left；不倒裝，也不在 did 後再用 left。

prompt: The doctor insisted that the patient ___ smoking immediately.
why: insist 表「堅持要求」時，that 子句用 (should) + 原形：(should) quit。若 insist 是「堅稱某事屬實」，才依事實使用一般時態。

prompt: 哪一句是正確的？
answer: He asked me where I bought the textbook.
options: He asked me where I bought the textbook.
He asked me where did I buy the textbook.
why: 間接問句為名詞子句，語序必須是「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」，不可保留助動詞 did 倒裝。

prompt: Why is the verb in 'AI diagnostic algorithms be subjected' in base form?
passage: Medical researchers strongly recommend that AI diagnostic algorithms be subjected to rigorous clinical validation. The fact that neural networks operate as black boxes raises ethical questions about accountability. Healthcare administrators must evaluate whether automated diagnosis truly improves patient outcomes or merely accelerates administrative procedures.
answer: Because 'recommend that' requires the subjunctive mood (should + base form).
options: Because 'recommend that' requires the subjunctive mood (should + base form).
Because the cargo and personal valuables were left undisturbed.
To introduce the adverse result of algorithmic feeds prioritizing sensationalism.
why: 文章依據：Because 'recommend that' requires the subjunctive mood (should + base form).

prompt: Please tell me ___.
why: 間接問句的子句用 where + 主詞 + 動詞。

prompt: We cannot overlook the startling fact ___ global sea levels are rising at an accelerated rate.
why: 同位語子句：the fact that + 完整客觀事實。 the fact that 經典同位語。

prompt: Our international science seminar will officially commence ___ 9:00 a.m. ___ Monday morning ___ early October.
why: 【考點解構】套用倒金字塔法則：特定時間點 9:00 a.m. 用 at；特定某天的早晨 (Monday morning) 用 on；月份十月 (October) 用 in，因此唯一正確搭配為 at; on; in。

prompt: 哪一句是正確的？
answer: The platform on which we met was crowded.
options: The platform on which we met was crowded.
The platform on that we met was crowded.
why: 介系詞後絕不可使用關係代名詞 that，指物時必須用 which。

prompt: Why is 'which' used in 'an environment about which' instead of 'that'?
passage: In 1960, Jane Goodall arrived at the Gombe Stream reserve in present-day Tanzania, an environment about which the scientific world knew very little. She observed primates whose intricate social hierarchies amazed ethologists. The breakthrough discovery that chimpanzees make and use tools, an ability with which humans previously credited only themselves, fundamentally revolutionized anthropology.
answer: Because 'that' cannot follow a preposition directly in a relative clause.
options: Because 'that' cannot follow a preposition directly in a relative clause.
The metropolis is now believed to have supported more than one hundred thousand inhabitants.
Because 'to' in 'be accustomed to' is a preposition requiring a gerund.
why: 文章依據：Because 'that' cannot follow a preposition directly in a relative clause.
